articles.summary: Herc Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HRI), one of North America’s leading equipment rental suppliers operating through Herc Rentals Inc. (“Herc Holdings,” “Herc Rentals” or the “Company”), today announced that Luis Machado has joined the company as senior vice president, chief legal officer and secretary. In this role, Machado will lead all aspects of Herc Holdings’ legal function, including contractual- and transaction-related legal activities and regulatory and litigation matters. In addition, he will oversee the company’s corporate governance and statutory reporting requirements. Machado has more than three decades of corporate legal experience at public companies across the construction, manufacturing, automotive, retail, food and beverage, and distribution industries. Most recently, Machado served as vice president, general counsel and secretary of TopBuild Corp., responsible for all board, governance, public reporting, MA, and litigation matters. articles.summary: Herc Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: HRI), one of North America’s leading equipment rental suppliers operating through Herc Rentals Inc. (“Herc Holdings,” “Herc Rentals” or the “Company”), has once again been recognized as a top employer for military veterans and active service members by three national programs that evaluate organizations’ commitment to the military community. For the third time, Herc Rentals earned the HIRE Vets Gold Medallion. Presented by the U.S. Department of Labor, this is the only federal-level award recognizing employers for their commitment to veteran hiring, retention and professional development. Herc Rentals also earned its 12th consecutive Military Friendly® Employer designation, receiving the Gold designation for the fifth year in a row and a Top 10 ranking for the third time. The Company was recognized as a Military Friendly® Spouse Employer for the sixth consecutive year and was named to the Best for Vets: Employers list by Military Times for the fourth year.
articles.title: Herc Rentals Recognized Again for Veteran Hiring and Career Development by the U.S. Department of Labor, Military Friendly® and Military Times
